Name: (CP) Kat's Pet Shaymin
Author: katriex
Description:
[center][font=Verdana][color=#f4cccc][size=4]Mod Description[/size][/color][/font]
I'm back at it! Had this sitting around for a little while now, and finally got around to actually figuring out how to implement it ingame. This mod adds the Pokemon Shaymin as a new pet to adopt either at the start of the game or later on, thanks to 1.6 giving us the ability to adopt new pets! Due to it using this feature, the mod is not backwards compatible. So make sure you use this on 1.6!

[size=4][color=#f4cccc][font=Verdana]How To Install[/font]
[/color][/size]
[quote]1. Download Content Patcher if you don't already have it. (let's be real, who doesn't have it at this point.)
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip mod(s, if you needed to download CP) into your mods folder.
4. Shaymin should now be available either at the start of a new save file [color=#ff0000]or[/color] in Marnie's shop once you max hearts with your first pet and buy a pet bowl from Robin.[/quote]

[font=Verdana][color=#f4cccc][size=4]Additional Notes / Permissions[/size][/color][/font]﻿[quote]1. I will likely update this mod with an additional option for Shaymin's sky form later. For now, only land form exists in this mod. I also wanted to make them a barn animal(not coop because the sprites are too large), but need to redraw some of the sprites to fit those sprite sheets better, so the tiny hedgehog creature will remain a pet for now. (I'll keep the pet version, probably.)
2. The price at Marnie's is set to 60,000g. This can be changed via the config, just put in whatever number you'd like. (If you're in Marnie's shop when you change it, exit the building and reenter for the new value to take effect.)
3. Please keep in mind that these assets are not directly ripped from any Pokemon game. I drew these spritesheets myself. If you would like to use
these assets for anything, please ask me.
4. I will not take requests for other Pokemon or general animal replacement mods. Commissions can be discussed, but I don't do requests.[/quote][/center]
